notes: EXAMPLE. The hook is the zero address on purpose so a copy-paste run fails at startup. For a real config see keeper.config.robinhood.json. `distributor` is REQUIRED: an address, or null when the pool has none - say which.

feeSweep._comment: OPTIONAL. Sweeps accrued protocol fees to the controller's stored treasury every intervalSeconds. `sweep` is PERMISSIONLESS and takes no recipient, so this adds no privilege to the keeper: the worst a stolen keeper key achieves here is paying gas to move the protocol's revenue into the protocol's own Safe. Never point this at the owner-only `collect`. Zeros below are placeholders and fail at startup on purpose.

targets.label: CL manager / quote token
targets._minAmount: Optional floor in RAW units — a 6-decimal token and an 18-decimal one need very different numbers. Set it from what gas costs, not a round number.

launchpadV2._comment: OPTIONAL. LaunchpadKitV2 fee plumbing - three PERMISSIONLESS calls that pay only fixed recipients: kit.flushProtocolFees() sends launch fees to the kit's immutable protocolFeeRecipient; LatchLPLocker.collectFees(tokenId) and LatchBinLPLocker.collectFees(lockId) credit LP fees to each lock's creator/integrator/protocol split, fixed at lock. Every address is REQUIRED and may be null (not deployed): a null address registers no job. Kit v2 is not deployed on any chain as of 2026-09-14, so all three are null. The CL locker has no on-chain enumeration: list clTokenIds and/or set clDiscoverFromBlock (an L2 block, the eth_getLogs clock) to discover PositionLocked. Bin lock ids are read as 1..lockCount().
